IGUI_CSB_StudyBuildingTooltip: Look the building over and learn it, so you can build a copy of it somewhere else.
IGUI_CSB_StudyStructureTooltip: Look this roofed structure over and learn it: the roof, its posts and the floor under it.
IGUI_CSB_AlreadyKnown: You already know this one. Studying it again updates what you know.
IGUI_CSB_NotLoaded: Part of the building is too far away. Get closer and try again.
IGUI_CSB_TooBig: This roof is too big to study as a structure.
IGUI_CSB_StudyFailed: There is nothing here to study.
IGUI_CSB_RemoveCopyTooltip: Takes this copy down and puts the ground back. Whatever was cleared to build it does not come back.
